qa_pairs.question: What page number contains information about sun roof adjustment?
qa_pairs.answer: Sun roof adjustment information can be found on page 54-1.

qa_pairs.question: Which procedure is covered on page 54-2?
qa_pairs.answer: Sun roof winder - remove and install is covered on page 54-2.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure code for sun roof motor/gearbox removal and installation or replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: The procedure code for sun roof motor/gearbox - remove and install or replace is 54 13 010.

qa_pairs.question: On what page can I find information about convertible top canvas replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: Convertible top (canvas) - replace information can be found on page 54-16.

qa_pairs.question: What type of sun roof drive cables are mentioned and what pages cover their replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: Both manual and electric sun roof drive cables are mentioned. Manual cables are covered on page 54-5 and electric cables are covered on page 54-6.
